sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can say what people do to or with each other using egymás, and how well they get along.
I can talk about falling out and making up: veszekedik, összevész, kibékül, megbocsát.
I can talk about caring for, relying on and being attached to someone, and supporting each other.
I can concede a contrast with annak ellenére, hogy, and describe a friend with an aki-clause.
